images.filename: Boulia Heritage Complex Hamilton St Boulia Queensland P1040079.jpg
images.caption:
The Boulia Heritage Complex is located on Hamilton St at the intersection of Pituri St.  It features the heritage Stone House, vintage machinery, moonstones, marine fossils, part of a 'space race' rocket that fell from the sky and more.  Visitors can expect a friendly welcome.
Most of the Boulia Heritage Complex is very accessible for people who have disabilities.
